extraFacts.fact: The working load limit (WLL) is the maximum load a lifting component is rated to carry in service; proof load and minimum breaking load are test figures and are never used as working limits.
extraFacts.source: ASME B30.26 Rigging Hardware and EN 1677 Components for slings (definitions of working load limit and breaking force)

faqs.q: What is the Grade 100 Swivel Eye Nut and what is it used for?
faqs.a: Grade 100 eye nut with a swivelling eye: it screws onto a stud or threaded rod and the eye turns to face the pull, giving a rotating lifting point where a fixed eye nut would be loaded sideways.
